title: Bauhaus
look: Circles, squares and three primaries on cream, moving like a machine.

doc.essence: A character built the way a 1920s design school poster is: from circles, squares and bars, in red, yellow, blue and black on cream.
doc.notIt: Not flat (primaries only, sharp corners, a geometric composition behind, mechanical timing), not screenprint (no grain, no posterized character colour).
doc.shapes: Sharp corners everywhere, round knobs for hands, block feet. No outline: the shapes meet edge to edge.
doc.colour: The body takes the nearest primary, the details black, the accent the next primary. Eyes are black, or yellow on a black visor.
doc.eyes: A perfect dot that becomes a bar on a blink and a half disc when happy; the mouth is a half disc or a circle.
doc.motion: Mechanical: 10 fps steps that hold, then jump ahead together, like a machine indexing.
pitfalls: Characters whose colour sits between two primaries can flip to an unexpected one: set a per-style palette in the mascot.
